articles.title: Chew Away Your Worries? Teens Invent Anxiety-Fighting Gum!
articles.summary: Feeling nervous? Two high schoolers made a gum with passionflower extract that might help. They tested it at a huge science fair and won $600!

articles.title: Super Sponge Glass: The Ancient Trick That Could Clean Our Air!
articles.summary: Scientists used an old glassmaking trick to make a new kind of glass that can trap gases like CO2. It's like a sponge that soaks up pollution!

articles.title: 12 Secret Superpowers Your iPhone Just Got!
articles.summary: Apple's latest updates added cool hidden features: find concerts near you, new emoji, and even help switching to Android. Check them out!
